title: Cool Tavern Hotel & Bar
description: A modern, responsive hospitality website for Cool Tavern Hotel & Bar in Thika, Kenya, showcasing its restaurant, Kenyan cuisine, bar, guest accommodation, and event offerings. Built with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Supabase, with a focus on premium design, mobile responsiveness, and a scalable foundation for future hospitality features.
coverAlt: Cool Tavern Hotel & Bar hospitality website featuring Kenyan cuisine, bar experiences, and guest accommodation
